paite: Ka galvenna ah ka dingh dia, insang ah ka pang ding a, ka kiang a bang ahia agen chih thei ding in leh ka phunna tungtang bangchi in ka dawng dia chih thei ding in ka ngak ding hi.
heading: TOUPA'N Habakkuk Adawnna
english: I will stand at my watch and set myself on the ramparts, and will look out to see what he will say to me, and what I will answer concerning my complaint.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N kei ahon dawng a, mengmuh pen gelh inla, asim peuhmah atai theihna ding in, suangpekte ah kichiantak in gelh in.
english: Yahweh answered me, “Write the vision, and make it plain on tablets, that he who runs may read it.

paite: Mengmuh lah hun sehsa a ding ahi lai a, atawplam ah akinoh a, azuau kei ding; om tadih mahleh, ngak in; ahong tun ding ziak in, azekai kei ding hi.
english: For the vision is yet for the appointed time, and it hurries toward the end, and won’t prove false. Though it takes time, wait for it, because it will surely come. It won’t delay.

paite: Ngai in, akha kiliansak amah midiklou ahi, himahleh midiktat tuh ginna in ahing ding hi.
english: Behold, his soul is puffed up. It is not upright in him, but the righteous will live by his faith.

paite: Ahi, uain in lepchiahtak in a-omsak a, miki-uangsak, om kinken lou ahi; gawtmun bang a adeih hihlian, sihna bang ahi a, suklungkim theih ahi kei, nam tengteng amah ah akaikhawm zaw a, atung ah mipite tengteng asekhawm hi.
heading: Midiktatloute Tunggikna
english: Yes, moreover, wine is treacherous: an arrogant man who doesn’t stay at home, who enlarges his desire as Sheol; he is like death and can’t be satisfied, but gathers to himself all nations and heaps to himself all peoples.

paite: Hiaite tengteng in amah dem in gentehna agen un, amah demna paunak enghouna hiai bang a gen in, "Amah a lou hihpungpa tung agik!" Bang tan? chi in agen kei ding ua hia! Bang tan thil khamna zang a kihih inbulpa;
english: Won’t all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, ‘Woe to him who increases that which is not his, and who enriches himself by extortion! How long?’

paite: na leibatnate thakhat a hong thoukhia a, nang hon hihbuai ding a hong khanglou lou ding uhia? Nang amaute a ding a gallak suak ding hilou na hi maw?
english: Won’t your debtors rise up suddenly, and wake up those who make you tremble, and you will be their victim?

paite: Nam tampi na loh ziak in, mipi akhosuaksunte tengteng in nang ahon lok ding ua; mite sisan ziak in leh gam tung, khopi tung leh asung a teng tengteng tung a hiamgam na hihna ziak in.
english: Because you have plundered many nations, all the remnant of the peoples will plunder you because of men’s blood, and for the violence done to the land, to the city and to all who dwell in it.

paite: "Tunglam sang a abu asehtheihna ding leh gilou khut a kipan tatkhiak a-omtheihna ding a, a-inn a dia punna gilou mumi tung agik!"
english: Woe to him who gets an evil gain for his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the hand of evil!

paite: Mi tampi satkhia in, na hinna tung a khial in na inkote tung ah zumhuaina na zong ahi.
english: You have devised shame to your house by cutting off many peoples, and have sinned against your soul.

paite: Baang a kipan suang akikoukhe ding a, sing a kipan inkam in dawng ding ahih ziak in.
english: For the stone will cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the woodwork will answer it.

paite: "Sisan a khua lam a, khopi gitlouhna a dingsakmi tung agik!"
english: Woe to him who builds a town with blood, and establishes a city by iniquity!

paite: Ngai in, mite sepgimna mei a khul ding singkhuah bang leh namte kisukgimna uh bangmah lou a suah ding sepaihte' TOUPA thilgelsa ahi kei maw?
english: Behold, isn’t it from Yahweh of Armies that the peoples labor for the fire, and the nations weary themselves for vanity?

paite: Tuite'n tuipi akhuh bang in, TOUPA thupina theihna a leitung pumpi dim ding ahih ziak in.
english: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of Yahweh’s glory, as the waters cover the sea.

paite: A-inveng dawn ding pia a, huai a gu hel a, avuaktanna uh a-ettheihna ding a, amah khamsak lai mi tung agik hi!
english: “Woe to him who gives his neighbor drink, pouring your inflaming wine until they are drunk, so that you may gaze at their naked bodies!

paite: Thupina deihna in zumhuaina in na dim a; nang leng dawn inla, zeksumloupa bang in om in; TOUPA khut taklam nang lam ngatsak ahi ding a, na thupina tung ah zumhuaina hoih lou a-om ding hi.
english: You are filled with shame, and not glory. You will also drink and be exposed! The cup of Yahweh’s right hand will come around to you, and disgrace will cover your glory.

paite: Lebanon tung a hiamgam hihna in nang ahon khuh ding a, gamsate siatna in nang ahon lausak ding; gam tung, khopi leh asung a teng tengteng tung a hiamgam a mite sisan na suah ziak in.
english: For the violence done to Lebanon will overwhelm you, and the destruction of the animals will terrify you, because of men’s blood and for the violence done to the land, to every city and to those who dwell in them.

paite: A gelhmi in agelh, milim gelh; milim sun, zuaute sinsakpa, milim pau thei lou bawl ding a, huai a anasep bang phatuam ahia?
english: “What value does the engraved image have, that its maker has engraved it; the molten image, even the teacher of lies, that he who fashions its form trusts in it, to make mute idols?

paite: Sing kiang a, Halh in; suang pau thei lou kiang a, Thou in, chimi tung agik hi! Ngai in dangka-eng leh dangka a luan milim, amah ah nakna om lou in asinsak thei diam?
english: Woe to him who says to the wood, ‘Awake!’ or to the mute stone, ‘Arise!’ Shall this teach? Behold, it is overlaid with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all within it.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA atempul siangthou ah a-om a; ama ah leitung pumpi dai sipsip hen.
english: But Yahweh is in his holy temple. Let all the earth be silent before him!”
